abstract.p: This paper addresses causality detection in financial documents for the Spanish subtask of the FinCausal 2025 challenge. The task involved identifying cause-effect relationships using an extractive question-answering framework. We compared span extraction and generative approaches, with the latter demonstrating superior performance. Our best model, Super-LeNIA, achieved a Semantic Answer Similarity (SAS) score of 0.979 and an Exact Match score of 0.816 on the blind test set.
